welcome.title: Welcome to Renzzle
welcome.description:
It's a Gomoku puzzle app played with Renju rules.
Enjoy puzzles in three modes.

place.title: Placing a Stone
place.description:
Tap a point to select it, then tap the same point again to place a stone.
Place a stone on the marked point.

five.title: Five in a Row Wins
five.description:
Line up five stones horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to win.
Make five in a row with Black.
five.result: Black wins with five in a row.

forbiddenIntro.title: Forbidden Moves: Black Only
forbiddenIntro.description:
Black has the advantage of moving first.
So under Renju rules, Black loses by playing on certain points, called forbidden moves.
There are three kinds.

doubleThree.title: Double Three (3-3)
doubleThree.description:
A point where one move makes two threes.
A three is a shape that becomes a straight four with one more stone.

doubleFour.title: Double Four (4-4)
doubleFour.description:
A point where one move makes two fours.
A four blocked on one side still counts.

oneLineFour.title: Double Four in One Line
oneLineFour.description:
Two fours in the same line also make a double four.
After a stone here, filling either empty point makes five.

overline.title: Overline (Six or More)
overline.description:
A point that connects six or more stones in a row.
Black must make exactly five in a row to win.

instantLoss.title: Forbidden Move = Instant Loss
instantLoss.description:
In Renzzle, Black loses immediately after a forbidden move, with no warning.
Place a stone on the marked 3-3 point.

fourThree.title: Four-Three Is Allowed
fourThree.description:
A four-three makes a four and a three together, and it is not forbidden.
It's Black's classic way to win.
Make a four-three.

fivePriority.title: Five Beats Forbidden
fivePriority.description:
Black wins by making five in a row, even if the move also forms a forbidden shape.
This point makes a 3-3, but it also completes five.
Place a stone on the marked point.
fivePriority.result: Five comes first, so Black wins.

whiteFree.title: White Has No Restrictions
whiteFree.description:
White may play 3-3 and 4-4 freely.
Six or more in a row also wins.
Make six in a row with White.
whiteFree.result: White wins with six in a row.

You can open this guide again in Settings > Game Guide.
